prerequisites: Knowledge of mechanical technology / manufacturing technologies is useful, although not mandatory.

learning_outcomes.text: Know a structured approach and modern methods to develop new or improved products within a company, knowing how to address best the development of a new product depending on its features.

Develop a new product, accounting for market needs, the products / platforms from which to start, competing products, the processes to be implemented within the enterprise and internal/external resources to be committed.
Choose the architecture to be given to the product and to evaluate the number of units sold according to the concept developed, associating an assessment of the industrial cost.

Identify market opportunities for new products, evaluate product development, product structure, and business objectives between the market-pull and alternative (technology-push, custom, or platform), generate and select conceptual alternatives in a rational manner, taking into account the suitable performance compromises and verifying the sales potential of the product developed.
Transmit, in oral, written and graphical form, the process of developing a new product applied concretely to a case identified and assigned at the beginning of the course.
Communicate knowledge through appropriate means such as animated presentations, 3D CAD drawings, tables, diagrams, flow diagrams, and numerical spreadsheets.

Deepen knowledge of new product development methodologies through the autonomous consultation of specialized texts, scientific journals or dissertations, even outside lecture topics, to effectively tackle job placement or to undertake further training paths.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the product design and development process
Organization and management of development projects
Quality Function Deployment (QFD) and House of Quality (HOQ) in product design and development
Conceptual design: generation and selection of ideas
Lab classes on the use of 3D CAD in product development (SolidWorks software) for the design of parts and assemblies
teaching_methods: Frontal classroom lessons with PowerPoint slides
Laboratory exercises on the use of CAD 3D (SolidWorks software)
Collective discussion of student questions and solutions

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation and discussion of an innovative product development project

assessment_rules: The exam consists of the oral presentation and discussion of an innovative product development project. The project includes a report in Word, a PowerPoint presentation (maximum duration 25 min), and 3D CAD drawings of the developed product. The project concludes at the embodiment design stage. Evaluation, up to a score of 30/30 cum laude, is based on the presence of these elements, the comprehensiveness of the development activities shown, and the consistency and completeness of the activities' description.
bibliography: Ulrich K.T., Eppinger S.D., Product design and development, McGraw- Hill,5° Ed., 2011.

The slides displayed during the course are made available to students in PDF format along with other course materials (Word templates, Excel spreadsheets) on the Elly platform, after the student has enrolled to the course.
